agyos_skill.instructions: Deploy Expo applications to production environments, including app stores and over-the-air updates. Use this skill when you need to deploy Expo apps to production. Use this skill when: - Deploying Expo apps to production - Publishing to app stores (iOS App Store, Google Play) - Setting up over-the-air (OTA) updates - Configuring production build settings - Managing release channels and versions This skill provides guidance for deploying Expo apps: 1. **Build Configuration**: Set up production build settings 2. **App Store Submission**: Prepare and submit to app stores 3. **OTA Updates**: Configure over-the-air update channels 4. **Release Management**: Manage versions and release channels 5. **Production Optimization**: Optimize apps for production 1. Ensure all tests pass 2. Update version numbers 3. Configure production environment variables 4. Review and optimize app bundle size 5. Test production builds locally 1. Build production binaries (iOS/Android) 2. Configure app store metadata 3. Submit to App Store Connect / Google Play Console 4. Manage app store listings and screenshots 5. Handle app review process 1. Configure update channels (production, staging, etc.)
